title: Houthi Red Sea Expansion: Escalation Fork (Resource Strain or Regional Spread)
statement: Houthi coastal expansion along the Red Sea is highly escalatory and will bifurcate within ~90 days (by mid-December 2026): either (a) the US commits additional naval resources to Red Sea escort/interdiction beyond current CENTCOM posture — straining assets already saturated by the Hormuz blockade response — or (b) the theater spreads into regional war, most plausibly via Israeli strikes on Houthi infrastructure displacing the Oct 7 foreknowledge scandal (the Sept 8 divergence read: Israel needs escalation, America needs quiet). Distinct escalation pathway from the four logged theaters: proxy-at-chokepoint ignition (Bab el-Mandeb), which does not trip the direct Iran re-escalation triggers on the Master Thesis watchlist because the Houthis are Iranian-aligned but not Iranian-controlled. First theater to escalate via proxy rather than direct state action.
evidence_confirmed: Houthi coastal expansion reported along Red Sea littoral
US fleet saturation: escort duties already split between Gulf of Oman convoys and Persian Gulf posture (logged Sept 8-11 cycle)
Divergent-interests structure (2026-09-08 journal): Netanyahu 7 weeks from Israeli election with Oct 7 foreknowledge recording in hand — external escalation displaces scandal
Prior precedent: Israeli strikes on Houthi ports/Sana'a infrastructure established in earlier phases of the war
Master Thesis interlocking-theater mechanism: chokepoint competition draws belligerents in — Bab el-Mandeb is the second chokepoint after Hormuz
[2026-09-17] Entire Yemeni Red Sea coast under Houthi control; Mocha + islands seized; guns along 12-mi Bab el-Mandeb; Saudi vessels explicitly excluded from safe passage (Euronews/US News/NBC, 9/17)
evidence_contradicted: Houthi capability remains attritional/harassment economics, not sea-denial decisive
November Pause pressure: US incentive to keep Red Sea quiet into midterms cuts against both prongs short-term
EU Aspides escort mission already absorbs part of the Red Sea patrol burden without US escalation
falsifier: If Houthi coastal operations plateau or are absorbed by existing escort rotations (EU Aspides + current CENTCOM posture) with NO new US resource commitment to the Red Sea and NO Israeli-Houthi kinetic exchange by mid-October 2026, the escalation reading is dead and the track downgrades to ambient noise. Prong (a) falsified if US Red Sea posture stays flat through mid-December; prong (b) falsified if no Israeli strike on Yemen/Houthi targets and no Houthi strike on a US naval vessel in the window.
forward_watchlist: Israeli strikes on Houthi infrastructure (Yemen ports, Sana'a) — the regional-spread aperture
US carrier group repositioning toward Red Sea vs Gulf — the resource-strain tell
Tanker attacks resuming in Bab el-Mandeb (Suez transit rates as private-data tell for effective closure)
Any Houthi claim of hitting a US naval vessel — Article 5-adjacent fuse and Master Thesis uncontrolled-escalation trigger
Iranian resupply flow to Houthis (cross-check de-dollarization track if Iran diverts resources)
Interaction with SPR runway track (82): every Red Sea escort day competes with Hormuz convoy escort, feeding the oil clock

title: The War Question: Dueling Master Thesis (Spread Track)
statement: Paired duel track — confidence score = SPREAD, not probability. Thesis A (Interlocking-Theater Escalation, see interlocking-theater-escalation.json, 57): the turning manifests as real, sustained external war; fronts genuinely ignite each other. Thesis B (the Potemkin War, named for effect not intent): external war posture is theater — loud but shallow, sustained for narrative cover and emergency powers — then collapses into internal struggle; the real war is domestic. NOTE: the two theses are not opposites — both terminate in internal struggle; they differ only on route. Scores measure mechanism support from different evidence bases: A is anchored in seven months of escalation receipts; B is currently structure and incentive inference with few positive receipts. The spread (currently +9 toward A) is what moves; each of the three tells shifts it.
evidence_confirmed: November Pause logic already observed: regime incentive to keep external fronts quiet into midterms — consistent with war-as-theater rather than war-as-commitment
Divergent interests (Sept 8): Israel needs escalation, America needs quiet — the US side of that divergence is the Feint signature
Houthi Red Sea fork (76, logged 2026-09-11): resource-strain prong vs noise-without-commitment prong is now a live discriminator between the two theses
Domestic enforcement groundwork track running in parallel: apparatus pre-built for the internal landing regardless of external outcome
evidence_contradicted: Real resource commitments already exist: Hormuz convoy escort operations, ten tankers destroyed, month seven of the Iran war — the war is not purely theatrical
SPR runway track (82) treats the oil shock as a genuine fatality mechanism; a pure feint would not generate real scarcity dynamics
Escalation traps, once sprung, do not respect theatrical intent — Pape's escalation logic can force genuine commitment on an unwilling regime
falsifier: The duel resolves: if force posture, budgets, and casualty exposure stay flat while rhetoric spikes and domestic enforcement outpaces war spending through Q4 2026, B dominates and A weakens. If external theaters generate sustained verifiable resource commitment (permanent carrier repositioning, war appropriations exceeding domestic enforcement growth, a front the regime cannot de-escalate), A dominates and B dies. The spread collapses toward 0 only if the wire stays genuinely mixed — which is itself the honest forecast state.
forward_watchlist: TELL 1 — FORCE POSTURE: carrier group repositioning orders vs. home-port holding during the next rhetoric spike (A move: repositioning; B move: holding)

TELL 2 — BUDGET: FY27 supplementary war appropriations vs. DHS/ICE domestic enforcement line-item growth (the cleanest single metric — money is the one thing a Potemkin cannot fake for long; B signature = domestic wins)
TELL 3 — HOUTHI FORK: does the Red Sea theater (houthi-red-sea-escalation-fork, 76) draw real fleet assets (A) or strikes/statements with flat posture (B)?
SPREAD WATCH: log each tell movement to the mget_ledger as a duel-read; the spread is the forecast, not either thesis
LANDING CONVERGENCE: whichever thesis wins, watch the domestic apparatus activate — both routes terminate in internal struggle
Inversion twin: 9-11-inversion-false-flag (35) supplies the ignition; the Potemkin thesis supplies the sustained posture if B wins the route

title: Terminal Unwinding of the Post-WWII Global Order (CASS 94%)
statement: The four pillars of the post-WWII order (Pax Americana, Bretton Woods/dollar hegemony, technocratic neutrality, corporate apoliticalism) have simultaneously crossed their complexity caps. Their unwinding is irreversible under current institutional parameters — a systemic phase transition, not cyclical volatility. Reversion to factional capitalism, regionalized logistics, and hard-power competition is already underway.
